recording_year.Description: Year of the recording. The source sets NWB session_start_time to 1 January of the recording year 'to avoid disclosure of protected health information (PHI)'; only the year is meaningful and no acq_time is given.

source_file.Description: Original NWB file (DANDI asset path). Not included in this dataset because it embeds copyrighted stimulus images; obtain it from DANDI with the URL in sourcedata/sourcedata_provenance.json.

source_sha256.Description: SHA-256 of the source NWB file, equal to the DANDI asset digest dandi:sha2-256.

source_lfp_starting_time_s.Description: starting_time of acquisition/LFPs in the NWB session clock; event onsets are source times minus this value.

float32_max_abs_error_uV.Description: Largest absolute difference between the float32 values in the BrainVision file and the float64 source values (microvolts): the only change introduced by this conversion.
